description: This file defines an interface ICacheMonitor responsible for monitoring cache-related metrics such as pressure status, message counts, memory usage, and cache size reports in the Orleans Streaming framework.

classes.name: ICacheMonitor
classes.description: Interface for monitoring cache metrics, including pressure status, message counts, memory usage, and cache size.

methods.name: TrackCachePressureMonitorStatusChange
methods.description: Tracks changes in cache pressure monitor status, indicating if the cache is under pressure.

methods.name: TrackMessagesAdded
methods.description: Records the number of messages added to the cache.

methods.name: TrackMessagesPurged
methods.description: Records the number of messages purged from the cache.

methods.name: TrackMemoryAllocated
methods.description: Tracks memory allocated in the cache in bytes.

methods.name: TrackMemoryReleased
methods.description: Tracks memory released back to the pool in bytes.

methods.name: ReportMessageStatistics
methods.description: Reports statistics about message enqueue and dequeue times and total message count.

methods.name: ReportCacheSize
methods.description: Reports the total size of the cache in bytes.
